description: This file defines the ThemeImage class within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It models a theme image with properties such as content, filename, file type, and file size, including methods to access these properties and convert the object to an array.

classes.name: ThemeImage
classes.description: Represents a theme image with content, filename, type, and size properties, providing methods for access and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ThemeImage instance with content, filename, file type, and size.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the image, converting from resource if necessary.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the image.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all content-related properties are null, indicating an empty image.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the object properties into an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeImage object from an associative array.
